ASTRAL_DISC_STRIKING.description: You have done the Striking rite.  Force answers when you have the rod and the diagram.

ASTRAL_DISC_WARDING.description: You have done the Warding rite.  The tide will thicken for you, and you can taste it.

ASTRAL_DISC_CALLING.description: You have done the Calling rite.  What you call still wants its fee.

ASTRAL_DISC_TEMPERING.description: You have done the Tempering rite.  You can set a blessing into flesh or gear for a while.

ASTRAL_DISC_HEXING.description: You have done the Hexing rite, outside the hall.  Every curse asks for blood as well as tide.

ASTRAL_DISC_WAYFINDING.description: You have done the Wayfinding rite.  Bearings, marks, and short steps are open to you.

ASTRAL_DISC_MENDING.description: You have done the Mending rite.  You can close what is torn, if you have the time.

ASTRAL_DISC_SHAPING.description: You have done the Shaping rite.  Stone, soil, and rooted things will take a new shape from you.

lore_description: You are learning how the Craft is written down.  Lore is the skill of reading a grimoire, telling a real diagram from a doodle, and knowing which plane stained the tide in front of you.  It does not attune you.  It makes the reading less of a waste.
